required_nodes.rationale: Content identity, immutable generations, idempotence, and restart reconstruction.
The explicit body-domain coverage inventory preserves partial domains.
Three independent owners cross the later World-State boundary without synthesis.
The parameterized causal non-collapse table preserves lifecycle and substrate boundaries.
Conflicting owner values remain attributable without winner selection.
Provider failure degrades capture without fabricating or discarding successful reports.
Serialized custody excludes memory content and inferred allocations.
Authority, truth, maturity, effect-proof, and credential collapses fail closed.
Provider purity and the no-self-provider boundary are enforced.
Changed same-tick content and altered immutable custody fail closed.
Model-specific references change while introspection custody remains predecessor-bound.
Canonical run_loop loads explicit configuration, composes three live owner adapters, captures immutable generations, and exposes generation N only to a later World-State.
Absent configuration preserves the historical disabled daemon posture without custody writes.
Malformed explicit configuration is a deterministic blocked introspection surface, never silent disablement.
